yaw_root_cause_diagnosis.classification: fresh IMU sample with reset-relative orientation reference, plus separately implemented conversion paths

freshness.conclusion: The sample was genuinely fresh and was not a stale or zero-filled observation.

yaw_root_cause_diagnosis.persistence: The near-identity IMU orientation persists through fresh samples at simulation times 0.75, 0.85, and 0.95 seconds while odometry retains the seeded heading.
yaw_root_cause_diagnosis.model_configuration: renderSurveyorVrxModel emits the task_imu sensor without orientation_reference_frame/localization=ENU. Gazebo therefore reports orientation relative to its default/custom initial reference, making the seeded initial orientation appear near identity.

conversion_paths.assessment: The duplicate implementations are a structural defect and invalidate the earlier claim that the live observation used the TypeScript bridge. They produce the same pi/2-minus-yaw result for this sample, so duplication does not numerically cause the measured 1.716 rad error; the raw IMU reference does.

yaw_fix_verification.note_on_seed_30000_times: The equivalent reset-plus-three-step samples occurred at 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, and 0.90 simulation seconds because the asynchronous startup epoch settled one 50 ms physics tick earlier; all freshness ages were zero.
yaw_fix_verification.freshness: All IMU timestamps equaled their observation simulation times.
yaw_fix_verification.raw_quaternion_match: At every live sample, IMU and odometry quaternions were identical.

conversion_deduplication_verification.python_implementation: exact port with the same wrapping and 15-significant-digit language-boundary quantization
conversion_deduplication_verification.coverage: 5 roll values x 3 pitch values x 8 yaw values, including both pi boundaries

runtime.timing_basis: Gazebo /clock and sensor header simulation timestamps only

live_vrx_sensor_statistics.gps_statistical_behavior: PASS: component RMS is 0.790 m versus the shared model's configured 0.800 m per axis

stock_wamv_idle_stability.note: The initial vertical transient is settling to the stock waterline, not sustained sinking or launch. Stock 0.3-gain waves produce bounded wave-driven motion and are reported separately from the zero-disturbance numerical-noise check.
